children: JSW Dulux, a leading decorative and industrial paint manufacturer, plans to aggressively pursue  market expansion strategies after recording resilient double-digit volume growth despite macroeconomic headwinds, persistent geopolitical volatility, and sharp fluctuations in crude oil pricing.

The paint industry has been facing  margin pressures as crude oil-linked raw materials experience cost surges driven by geopolitical tensions in West Asia. Though leading companies have increased paint prices, they have to absorb marginal cost increase on their books to protect the demand.

Rajiv Rajgopal, Managing Director & CEO, JSW Dulux told businessline in an interaction that despite input cost spikes tied to international developments—including a recent 2 per cent anti-dumping duty (on few chemicals) and crude prices touching near-historic highs—the company has maintained its growth trajectory through deliberate pricing actions and robust product demand.

While historical pricing near $100–$105 per barrel created temporary inflationary headwinds, he said the company proactively implemented calibrated price hikes across categories. The company rolled out cumulative price increases, moving from initial assumptions of 93–96 levels up toward 94–96 brackets to protect bottom-line health.
While decorative segments smoothly absorbed price revisions, industrial product categories faced distinct cost adjustments requiring targeted recovery measures.
The company targets consolidated EBITDA margins within the 12-13 per cent range as manufacturing efficiencies and structural integrations scale up over upcoming quarters.
Consumer demand remains remarkably strong, buoyed by real estate expansion and discretionary home improvement projects, said Rajgopal.

Although rural markets faced localised challenges due to rainfall scarcity in select states, urban and semi-urban hubs—spanning metros and tier-I to -II cities—have demonstrated robust acceleration, he said.

The industrial coatings division continues to act as a vital growth engine. Fuelled by heavy demand across automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), power, oil and gas infrastructure, marine applications, and coil coatings, JSW Dulux’s industrial segments have posted impressive double-digit growth numbers.

The competitive landscape across India remains intensely active, with new market entrants maintaining pressure on baseline pricing. However, JSW Dulux has opted to avoid unsustainable trade spending or aggressive discounting, focusing instead on premium product differentiation and long-term brand equity.
The company plans to enhance its dealer network across core high-potential states, including Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra and West Bengal to widen market penetration.
It has also been gaining traction for its high-end innovations such as the luxury decorative line Dulux Velvet Touch Eternity and specialised automotive refinish products under the JSW Dulux banner.
As the company expects sustained demand, effective cost containment and aggressive dealer rollouts to safeguard margins and secure higher single-to-double-digit volume expansions.

title: JSW Dulux navigates volatile crude oil, cost pressures to drive volume growth
